3. Tenderer shall quote in the Price Bid (.xls format) sheet only in accordance with the ITT
clause 10. Tenderer is advised to quote their percentage rate in two decimals for
Schedule-A. Tenderer has to select option “At Par / Excess / Less” and enter percentage
rate in figures on estimated cost to Schedule-A, for Schedule-B tenderer is required to
select percentage option as ‘At Par’ only and for Schedule-C tenderer shall offer Credit
to BMRCL on Salvage of Materials, in ‘Lump sum’ amount.
